message: 壁
After school. To steel ourselves, we decided to hold voluntary training as the Crusaders.
...However, I don't know what specifically we should do or how to go about it.
Until a good idea comes to mind, I take a stroll while thinking about this and that.

name: Synn
message: 「I-I ended up coming to the shopping district without realizing it. Could there be a hint for strengthening our fighting power here?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aren't you just domestic to the bone?」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Look, if you pay attention to your diet, you get a healthy body, right? Isn't that true for all athletes?」

name: Synn
message: 「If the Crusaders make sure to eat good food too, we should get stronger.」

name: Paqy
message: 「By that logic, wouldn't that angel who eats high-end cuisine practically every day be the strongest?」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, Lord Synn, pardon me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan? You're wearing a shrine maiden outfit--are you running an errand for the shrine?」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm, how ought I to answer that... You are half-correct.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's see, let's see?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoaaa, it's packed to the brim with salted kelp!」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Paqy, I told you not to peek into other people's shopping bags without asking!」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, normally I would cut down an apparition on the spot, yet being seen with this is of no consequence.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I like your style, naginata lass. Gonna have a drink with this as a snack? Pretty refined--let the great me join in too.」

name: Shio
message: 「How rude! I do not indulge in madness-inducing water! Prepare for judgment!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Zodan!? Y-You're actually slashing at me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course she is. If you treat her like an old man, naturally even Shio-chan's going to get mad.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh, I am delighted. Lord Synn, you view me as a maiden, do you not?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Y-Yeah.」

name: Shio
message: 「What is the meaning of that suggestive pause? Moreover, you were stammering?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's just your imagination. I was just deep in thought about Student Council matters.」

name: Shio
message: 「Pondering your own duties, you say? What a coincidence, for I was doing the very same.」

name: Shio
message: 「As a member of the Asukai, I procure ingredients; and as a mere girl, I am learning how to cook」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm? If I'm half right, does that mean the cooking part is for personal reasons?」

name: Shio
message: 「H-How embarrassing」

name: Shio
message: 「I have been learning how to make oshiruko at Yuugiri-an, yet I am struggling to improve...」

name: Shio
message: 「It is much like naginata training」

name: Shio
message: 「One progresses steadily through discipline, only to suddenly hit a wall one day and stagnate」

name: Shio
message: 「After a period of diligent refinement and anguish, one's skill rises again, only to encounter the next wall. It is an endless cycle」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Shio
message: 「F-Forgive me, that was rather stiff talk」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it was really helpful」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, treat me to some of your home cooking sometime, okay?」

name: Shio
message: 「Then please pay a visit to our shrine during the sacred rites of the eleventh month. I shall gladly serve you my homemade oshiruko」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'll definitely stop by」

name: Shio
message: 「Now then, as I have purification rites to attend to, I shall take my leave」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, see you later」

name: Synn
message: 「...I get it, that huge amount of salted kelp was meant as a side dish」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, let's get going too, Paqy. I can't quite put it into words, but Shio-chan gave me a hint」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, he's still passed out...」
